business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- The company is presented as a group of five reporting entities rather than a single plant: Jash Engineering Ltd., Rodney Hunt Inc., Mahr Maschinenbau GmbH, Waterfront Fluid Controls Ltd. and Jash Process Equipment Pvt. Ltd., each carrying its own order book and FY26-27 sales outlook.
- Demand is skewed overseas: of the Rs 932 Cr* consolidated order book as on 1st August 2026, Rs 639 Cr is 'Outside India' against Rs 293 Cr 'Within India'; the FY26-27 sales outlook is similarly split Rs 555 Cr outside India vs Rs 320 Cr within India.
- The CMD frames the durable strengths as 'enhanced manufacturing capabilities, a diversified global presence and a robust project pipeline', with the 'healthy order book' cited as the source of 'strong revenue visibility'.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Order book] Consolidated order book as on 1st August 2026 is stated as Rs 932 Cr*, footnoted 'Combined order booking after deducting inter-company orders'. Entity-wise the deck lists Jash Engineering Ltd. Rs 559 Cr, Rodney Hunt Inc. Rs 369 Cr, Mahr Maschinenbau GmbH Rs 31 Cr, Waterfront Fluid Controls Ltd. Rs 34 Cr and Jash Process Equipment Pvt. Ltd. Rs 29 Cr; these are pre-elimination entity figures and are not additive to the Rs 932 Cr headline.
- [Order pipeline] Beyond the order book, the deck shows a pipeline as on 1st August 2026 in two buckets, 'Already negotiated' and 'Under negotiation', with combined values of Rs 72 Cr (Within India Rs 19 Cr, Outside India Rs 53 Cr) and Rs 60 Cr (Within India Rs 34 Cr, Outside India Rs 26 Cr). Which bucket carries which of the two combined totals is not recoverable from the text extraction, so the mapping is not asserted here.
- [Sales outlook] Consolidated sales outlook for FY26-27 of Rs 875 Cr*, footnoted 'Combined sales is arrived after deducting inter-company sales', split Within India Rs 320 Cr and Outside India Rs 555 Cr. The slide lists Jash Engineering Ltd, Rodney Hunt Inc., Mahr Maschinenbau GmbH, Waterfront Fluid Controls Ltd. and Jash Process Equipment Pvt. Ltd. against Rs 530 Cr, Rs 330 Cr, Rs 15 Cr, Rs 60 Cr and Rs 40 Cr in that order; this entity-to-value binding is positional in the extract and the entity figures are pre-elimination.
- [Group structure] The deck reports a 'Share of profit/ (loss) of a joint venture' line in the consolidated income statement, indicating a joint venture exists, but the deck names neither the JV nor its business.

deepdive.thesis: Jash Engineering's Q4FY26 results were impacted by US tariff uncertainty and Middle East war, but domestic business growth and forex gains helped mitigate the decline, with the company guiding for 12-13% PAT margins in FY27.
